calculation.description: Negative three-day average overnight gap. Assets with persistently positive gaps are expected to mean-revert on the next daily close; negative gaps receive positive reversal scores. Computed using only completed prior-day OHLC data at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (0.035434, ICIR 0.123561) and 2023-2024 (0.029685, ICIR 0.087211); weaker 2025-2026 (0.015651, ICIR 0.050957). Conservative inference warranted for the 15-instrument universe and shorter 321-date artifact sample.
